plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Political Science (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Select from MATH 140 , MATH 142 . MATH 151 , MATH 152 ; PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn3] Select any 100-499 course not used elsewhere (except POLS 100-499).
[grid1 fn4] Students must complete this course before taking more than 6 hours of 300- or 400-level courses in Political Science.
[grid1 fn5] POLS 100-499 cannot fulfill this requirement.
[grid1 fn6] Select from POLS 100-499 (except POLS 200 , POLS 206 , POLS 207 , POLS 209 , POLS 308 , POLS 309 ).
